[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Adds a short intro event for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22270][b]PixelPals Plushies[/b][/url] after Fall 1 of Year 1.
Just enter [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Pierre%27s_General_Store][b]Pierre's General Store[/b][/url]. He will be installing the machine.

The machine won't appear until after the cutscene happens.
This mod was written for my collection, [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/7330]Stardew Parade[/url][/b]!
